title: Compatible base and member presentations present every Čech intersection
statement: Let Y be a scheme and U_a→V a Fin n-indexed family in Y.ProEt. Fix a small category I and a relative-limit presentation P of the family along Y.Etale→Y.ProEt. If the underlying scheme cones of its base and members are limits, then the canonical cone from each nonempty repeated intersection of U to the corresponding stage intersections is a scheme limit. These constructions also give the functorial, face-compatible transition maps and cone legs of [def-cbc-affine-etale-cech-system]; affine base and members make all stage intersections affine.

source.place: Tag 099U, condition (3), finite Čech limit reductions; Tags 099T, 01ZM, 01ZN and 07RP. The proof also uses the explicitly named, already proved WeilConjectures and Mathlib declarations.

proof.text: Identify a product in an over-category with a wide pullback using Over.ConstructProducts.conesEquiv and IsLimit.ofRightAdjoint. Map its limiting cone by any finite-limit-preserving functor. Lift the base and factor maps to construct nerveMap. Its projection equations imply the face, identity, composition and cone naturality equations.

For a test cone to the stage intersection diagram, project to the base and member diagrams. Their limit properties give maps to the original base and each original member. Equality after every base cone leg proves compatibility, so the original wide-pullback property combines the maps. Checking all base and factor projections proves its factorization and uniqueness. Scheme.isAffine_of_isLimit proves affineness of every stage wide pullback.
Package the constructed transitions, cones, face equations and affine proofs as systemOfPresentation in [def-cbc-affine-etale-cech-system].
